summary: Preserved candidate PR 2763's opt-in side-effect-aware step-reuse framework and corrected the independently reproduced cache-aliasing defect: every skipped step now receives an independently owned clone, so an in-place scheduler or consumer cannot corrupt StepReuseState.last_real_prediction. The framework remains disabled by default and is not presented as validated for a concrete stateful diffusion architecture.

remaining_limitations: No concrete model adapter or qualified stateful diffusion model/weights were available; request/modality/CFG semantics, thresholds, cache-off/on output quality, full trajectories, and persistent session/KV equality remain unvalidated.
Only one GPU was assigned, so real multi-rank agreement and collective-control-flow safety remain unverified; only the candidate's synthetic control/follower token test ran.
Model-specific _run_denoising_step overrides that bypass the shared implementation require explicit integration before reuse can be enabled for those architectures.
The deterministic tiny Llama fixture cannot qualify diffusion architecture semantics, stateful writes, output quality, or a distributed workload.
